newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising in continuous rally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising in continuous rally.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may continue its rally amid sustained retail buying of select blue chips, brokers said.
"There is a...rush of new buyers in the market which is pushing the market higher and higher everyday. Everybody...wants to invest in the market," said broker M. A. Hossain.
Broker Shahidullah Shaymol said: "The market will continue its rally today. There will be shortage of blue chips as few will want to sell them when prices are rising."
Brokers, however, said the current bullish trend, propelled by euphoric trading by small investors, was not a healthy sign for a market.
The DSE all-share price index closed 62.04 points or 4.66 percent up at 1,390.84 on a turnover of 195.3 million taka on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
